name: 8-Relay Switch Bank
summary: 8-relay, 8-input boat switch bank over Signal K and NMEA 2000
description: Firmware for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO-C industrial relay board: 8 relays you can switch and 8 isolated inputs you can read, over Signal K (WiFi or Ethernet) and NMEA 2000 (PGN 127502/127501) at the same time. Per relay: name, latching or momentary with auto-off, and a chosen behaviour on Signal K loss or restart. Time-based schedules kept on the board's own real-time clock.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO-C
boards.notes: 8 MB octal PSRAM (ESP32-S3R8), 16 MB flash, W5500 Ethernet plus WiFi fallback, isolated CAN transceiver for NMEA 2000.
